subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers adopt and port the open cross-repository PR for this issue, or close it and allow a fresh narrow replacement against the current Channels view path?
rationale: The source-level bug remains, but there is already an open closing PR whose diff targets the pre-move file path, so ClawSweeper should not create a duplicate fix without maintainer direction.

options.title: Adopt or port linked PR
options.body: Review the open cross-repository PR, port the same behavior to the current `ui/src/pages/channels/view.ts` surface if needed, and close this issue after merge.

options.title: Allow a replacement fix
options.body: Close or explicitly supersede the linked stale-path PR and let a fresh narrow PR implement the same behavior on current main.

options.title: Leave both pending
options.body: Keep this issue and the linked PR open until a Control UI owner decides whether the broader channel directory redesign should absorb the fix.

recommendation.title: Adopt or port linked PR
recommendation.body: Review the open cross-repository PR, port the same behavior to the current `ui/src/pages/channels/view.ts` surface if needed, and close this issue after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history on the current Channels view move and the earlier channel UI metadata implementation.
